numbers.source_quote: 公司股票于 2026 年 8 月 12 日、8 月 13 日连续 2 个交易日
收盘价格涨幅偏离值累计超过 20%
于 2026 年 8 月 14 日披露的《关于公司被债权人申请重整及预重整的提示性公告》
于2026年8月13日收到浙江省宁波市中级人民法院

key_points.point: Abnormal movement = cumulative closing-price deviation exceeding 20% over the two consecutive trading days 8/12 and 8/13 (SSE trading-rules definition)
Timeline: the court Notice was received 8/13, overlapping the 8/12-13 price movement; the restructuring disclosure (8/14) came AFTER the movement

Review conclusion: apart from the restructuring alert announcement, no material matters that should have been disclosed were left undisclosed (controlling shareholder and actual controller were consulted in writing)

claim_evidence.evidence_quote: 连续 2 个交易日内收盘价格涨幅偏离值累计超过 20%
于2026年8月13日收到浙江省宁波市中级人民法院
不存在应披露而未披露的重大事项

notes: The cross-document timeline is the crux: receiving the court Notice (8/13, restructuring filing) vs the price anomaly window (8/12-13, anomaly filing) can only be assembled from BOTH files - a single document cannot yield K2. A correct fact cited to the wrong file loses citation points (source_file validation). Evidence quotes remain in the original Chinese.
